description: Maillage Cyclable - Points-Noeuds (Points) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CD25. The Point-Node cycling network is based on a system of junction staking and numbering, which allows users to be referred to other numbered junctions in order to create a tailor-made route. This mesh is designed to offer total freedom to all users. Coverage: CD25. The portal shows the English title as "Cyclable mesh - Node-Points (Points)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CD25. Its keywords include cyclable, route, territoire, tourisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
